title: nan
authors: Wagner W.J.; Blankenau I.; DeLaTorre M.; Purushottam A.; Soylemezoglu A.
key_contribution: Presents TRAELS, a terrain-referenced navigation localization system for UGVs in unstructured outdoor GNSS-denied environments, with demonstrated absolute trajectory error below 3 m.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
